title: Chocolate protein overnight oats
description: No-cook rolled oats soaked overnight in chocolate protein milk with Greek yogurt and chia, topped with banana.
draft_note: Draft quantities: adjust them in the app. Not plannable until the powder's carbs and fat per scoop are filled in (A2).

steps.text: Set out 2 jars with lids. Slice the banana only when serving.
Whisk the protein powder into the milk until smooth.
Stir in the Greek yogurt, oats and chia seeds until evenly combined.
Divide between the 2 jars, seal and refrigerate overnight so the oats soften.
Stir, then top with sliced banana when serving.
Keep the jars sealed in the fridge.
